parameters.name: BucketName
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese.

- **en**: English.

parameters.name: ObjectKeyList
parameters.description: A list of objects to scan in the OSS bucket. You can specify up to 50 ObjectKeys.

parameters.name: ServiceRegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the OSS bucket is located.

parameters.name: TemplateId
parameters.description:
The ID of the industry-specific template.

> Call **DescribeCategoryTemplateList** to get a list of templates. If you do not specify this parameter, the default active template is used for the scan.
